entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard Mr. Bhosale, learned Counsel for the Applicant and  Ms. Yadav, learned APP for the Respondent - State.

2. The Applicant by the present Application filed under Sec  of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("CrPC") is seeking pre-a  bail in connection with C. R. No. 324 of 2022 registered with the  Indapur Police Station, Pune (Rural) for the offences punishable  Sections 328 & 188 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Secti  26(2), 26(2)(a), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e) & 59 of the Food Safety and  Standards Act, 2006.
 3.

A learned Single of this Court (Coram : N. J. Jamadar, 
 Order dated 06.07.2022
has already granted interim protection to   Applicant.

sentences.text:
Learned APP states that Charge-sheet has been filed on  24.03.2025.
 5.
Thus, investigation is complete.
Accordingly, case is made out for  grant of Anticipatory Bail.
6. The Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of on the following  terms & conditions.
O R D E R (i)

In the event of arrest of the Applicant - Imran Hussain Shaikh in connection with C. R. No. 324 of 2022 registered with the Indapur Police Station, Pune (Rural), the Applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing P. R.Bond in the sum of Rs. 30,000/- with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount.
(ii) The Applicant shall furnish his cell phone number and residential address to the Investigating Officer and shall keep the same updated, in case of any change thereto.

(iii) The Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat, or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such a person from disclosing the facts to the Court or to any Police personnel.
(iv) The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence and shall not contact or influence the Complainant or any witness in any manner.
(v) The Applicant shall not leave India without prior permission of the Court.
7. The Anticipatory Bail Application is disposed of accordingly.

(MADHAV J. JAMDAR, J.)
